independent_audit.fixture_provenance: Independently created Rust fixtures in the hashed contract source; no supplied user mesh or commercial fixture/source used. Large unused-point meshes isolate decoder/count guards from triangulation algorithms.

audit_findings: No blocking correctness issue found in the reviewed shared-core implementation.
Active object occupies top-level geometry; exactly its scene payload is null. Inactive objects retain Arc-backed complete state. Active ray-hit ties win exact overlaps.

Scene-wide count/capacity charges cover positions/normals/masks/colors/triangles, retained levels, layer arrays and Morph arrays before vector reserve. RAII scope restoration on nesting/panic is source-reviewed; direct private tests are owner-scoped, not part of these22 public contracts.
Meaningful scene operations persist v5 identity/allocator even after deleting back to one object; read-only and true no-op implicit actions retain v2/v3/v4 as appropriate.
Selection is navigation without its own undo entry; edit Undo restores the originating object. Redo restores the whole pre-Undo state, including selection changes made after the edit.

Topology workers preserve inactive objects; zero-collapse reduction preserves the entire scene. Useful active reduction clears only that object target/hierarchy and whole-document acceptance remains undoable.
Scene byte budgets concern retained/decoded array storage, not total peak process memory. Encoded source strings and temporary validation/recomposition buffers are additional allocations.
limitations: These tests do not establish reference SubTool/folder/boolean/merge/split behavior or practical multi-object capacity/latency.

Hidden selected objects remain hidden; Solo follows active ID and never overrides explicit visibility. Host disables sculpting hidden objects; this differs from some reference selection/visibility behavior.
No browser/native app interaction performed. Runtime rendering, active-only host sculpting and consumer file flow require the parent-owned checks.

Any-order public tests explicitly cover geometry and mixed layer arrays; every malformed size/category combination is not exhaustively enumerated. Morph/normal/color/residual charging is additionally source-reviewed.

Both runs passed; no failed executable check was discarded. run-1 metadata initially described20 contracts by a counting typo; its immutable log actually contains19. Three justified coverage additions produce the final22.
Suite durations are debug test durations while other project validation could be active, not isolated operation benchmarks.

reference_context.derived_scope: Separate polygon objects, one active edited object, visibility/Solo, Append/Insert and richer folders/bulk operations are described; reference workflow equivalence was not tested.
